desc: You asked. We delivered more. 1911 Target that packs the powerful 22 magnum cartridge with a 14-round capacity. Engineered with a pinned, solid state 5” barrel with delayed blow back slide and our crisp, factory 4- to 6-pound trigger to offer match class accuracy and power. Includes rear adjustable sights with front fiber optic with dovetail cut with skeletonized hammer and trigger with adjustable over travel stop. The XT Magnum is finished with rock-tough parkerized coating, fitted G10 grips and comfort extended beaver tail safety.
